name: Repetition-Free Recursive Teaching Dimension of the Three-Code Class
proof: For the three concepts $000,011,101$, use respectively the one-coordinate teaching samples at coordinates $3,2,1$ (with their displayed labels).  Each sample identifies its target among all three concepts, and the coordinate sets $\{3\},\{2\},\{1\}$ are distinct.  Thus these removals give a repetition-free recursive plan of order one, which is optimal for a non-singleton class.
